title: Minab - September 3rd, A girl injured in the U.S's attack on a wedding in Sirik talks about that night.
text:
Minab - September 3rd, A girl injured in the U.S's attack on a wedding in Sirik talks about that night."

""
"SOT, Injured Girl (Farsi): "First, there was the sound of an explosion that hit the pier and then the derrick, then we heard something was heading towards the roof. The sound came suddenly and hit the house; we were thrown a bit inside the house, and I fell in the room. When it hit the house, everything exploded and a stone fell on my shoulder.
